summary: Put Stable and Development download cards at the top of the website home page with an All Releases link, fed by a latest.json the release publisher writes per channel; fix download pages being served as application/octet-stream. Name installer ISOs, source bundles, manifests and download folders with the readable version (no ~~).

guide.reason: The publish guide describes latest.json, the home page cards and the host nginx steps for existing hosts.

api.reason: Static website files and a static JSON file in the public download tree. No Controller operation, Core agent command, client API or observed-state flow changes.

roadmap.reason: Website presentation only; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.reason: latest.json is derived by the release publisher from the published download tree; the site holds no product, pool or Controller state.

verification.method: tests.test_release_publish and tests.test_website_hosting (real nginx) pass; svelte-check and npm run build pass. Browser check against the deployed site at desktop and 390 px width: both cards filled from the live manifests, ISO/netinst/hash links and All Releases resolve, no console errors, no horizontal overflow. HEAD requests to the linked ISOs returned 200. Not exercised: a real release run publishing a new latest.json, and a browser with JavaScript disabled (prerendered fallback links were inspected in the built HTML only). Artifact renaming: release-publish, ci-security, netinst, gitea-release, source-bundle and release-version tests pass; installer/build.sh passes bash -n; a publisher run over a mixed legacy (~~) and readable tree orders, prunes and writes latest.json correctly. Not exercised: a full ISO build and a real Release run with the renamed artifacts.
